# `igdev module cache-path`

cache-path prints where igdev keeps the module artifacts it downloads once for
the whole machine, keyed by Ignition version. It is the answer to "where would a
shared module live", and it is printed as a bare path in the human dialect so a
script can use it directly.

The cache is disposable: deleting it costs a re-download and nothing else, and the
directory being absent is reported, never failed on. Moving a repository's private
modules into that cache is `igdev module add --global`, which this release does not
have yet.

## Usage

```text
igdev module cache-path [flags]
```

## Examples

```text
  igdev module cache-path
  igdev module cache-path --json
```

## Options

```text
  -h, --help   help for cache-path
```

## Global options

```text
      --config stringArray   override one config key for this run, key=value (highest precedence)
      --json                 emit the JSON envelope on stdout (machine mode)
```

## Agent usage

pass --json for the machine contract. data carries path (the machine-wide
cache directory for this Ignition version), ignition_version, and exists. An absent
directory is normal: the cache is disposable and is created on first use, so data.exists
false is never an error.
